runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 13:29 sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. Existing Hilti Implementation & Service Specialist was reverified on the direct company career page and remains eligible: Bratislava, 1,800 EUR base plus annual bonuses, SŠ with maturita, English only an advantage. LinkedIn surfaced a newly indexed Bratislava city IT Technician, but same-run public evidence is insufficient to safely distinguish a genuinely fresh open requisition from older near-identical/stale postings, so it was not promoted. Kanadevia IT ServiceDesk requires at least two years of similar experience and good English; Wolt requires B2 English. Foxelli is Slovakia-eligible remote but current support role requires fluent/near-native English plus sewing specialization. Umbrel generic Remote still lacks explicit Slovakia hiring entitlement. Upwork discovery produced several Worldwide WordPress/VA items, but the freshest close fits were either ambiguous/low fixed-price, strong-English or stale/high-competition. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 verifiable hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Stale-listing resurrection guard
developmentChanges.reason: When search results label a role as newly posted but another canonical/job-ID variant is old, closed or near-identical, compare job IDs, apply-state and canonical detail before counting it as fresh. Prevents stale LinkedIn/aggregator listings from being resurrected into LIVE merely because the index timestamp changed.

developmentChanges.title: Verified-existing direct-source recheck budget
developmentChanges.reason: Reserve part of each run for rechecking the oldest high-fit LIVE direct-company records and store a separate reverified timestamp without deleting them when discovery misses them. Improves trust in LIVE freshness while preserving fail-closed behavior.
